table: Average class size in public K-12 schools, by school level, class type, and selected school characteristics: 2020-21
title: Average public school class size
quote: Average class size, all public school teachers: elementary 19.1 (self-contained) and 20.7 (departmentalized); middle 16.9 and 22.0; secondary/high 17.2 and 21.0; combined 17.1 and 17.9.
limits: A class is not an acquaintance circle: the class sizes bound the size of a generated school peer group, they do not measure how many classmates a person remembers. National only.
